official.deadline_central_display: Early Bird: tuition fee paid within three weeks of the admission results being published
official.deadline_note: There is no separate scholarship deadline. The discount is triggered by paying the first-year tuition within three weeks of the admission results; Oulu points applicants to the bachelor's and master's admission deadline pages for the exact payment deadline, and notes there are no first-year applications at all for the tuition fee waiver.
official.application_cycle: Admission in the autumn 2026 or spring 2027 rounds for studies beginning in the 2027-2028 academic year
official.status_note: The University's page states that the information applies to students admitted during the autumn 2026 or spring 2027 admission rounds for studies beginning in the 2027-2028 academic year, and that the Early Bird discount is granted on payment within three weeks of the results.
official.tuition_coverage_note: "The University of Oulu does not offer scholarships that cover 100% of the tuition fee"; support is a programme-specific percentage of the annual tuition fee, either as the Early Bird discount on year one or as a tuition fee waiver from the second year onwards.
benefits: Early Bird discount on the first-year tuition fee, ranging from 5% to 30% depending on the degree programme
Tuition fee waiver scholarship from the second year onwards, ranging from 5% to 40% of the annual tuition fee depending on the programme
Nokia Scholarships of EUR 3,000 each for a limited number of accepted applicants in specific ICT master's programmes, open also to tuition-fee payers
The International Business Management (Bachelor's + Master's) route carries a 20% waiver during the bachelor's phase and 30% during the master's phase for continuing students
eligibility: Admitted to an English-taught Bachelor's or Master's degree programme at the University of Oulu
Not a citizen of an EU/EEA country or Switzerland and no residence permit exempting from tuition fees
Early Bird: pay the tuition fee within three weeks of the admission results being published
Tuition fee waiver from year two: complete at least 60 ECTS credits during the preceding academic year in accordance with the approved study plan, including the required Finnish language studies
requirements: Pay the full first-year tuition fee in a single payment by the deadline to obtain the Early Bird discount
Confirm the study place, then register for the academic year
From the second year onwards, meet the 60 ECTS progress requirement including the required Finnish language studies
Meet any additional programme-specific requirements published for the tuition fee waiver
documents: Proof of payment of the tuition fee through Flywire, which is what triggers the Early Bird discount
An approved study plan showing at least 60 completed ECTS credits for the second-year waiver
Evidence of the completed Finnish language studies included in the approved study plan
selection_criteria: The Early Bird discount is granted automatically on payment within three weeks of the results, not on competitive assessment
Tuition fee waivers are awarded on successful progress in studies, with the percentage fixed per degree programme
The waiver percentage differs by programme, so the same 60 ECTS effort is worth different amounts in different programmes
Faculty-funded scholarships are not available for first-year students
coverage: Early Bird discount: 5% to 30% of the first-year tuition fee depending on the degree programme
Tuition fee waiver: 5% to 40% of the annual tuition fee from the second year onwards depending on the degree programme
Nokia Scholarship: EUR 3,000 in selected ICT master's programmes
application_method: Apply to the English-taught programme through the admission process and accept the study place
Pay the tuition fee through Flywire within three weeks of the admission results to obtain the Early Bird discount - no separate scholarship application is needed
Register for the academic year once the study place is confirmed
From the second year, qualify automatically for the tuition fee waiver by completing at least 60 ECTS credits per the approved study plan
official.application_route: No scholarship application: the Early Bird discount is granted by paying the first-year fee within three weeks of the results, and year-two waivers follow from completing 60 ECTS in the previous year.
official.study_mode: Full-time study in an English-taught Bachelor's or Master's degree programme
official.citizenship_residency: Open to students who are not citizens of an EU/EEA country or Switzerland and who do not hold a Finnish residence permit exempting them from tuition fees.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the fees and support scheme exists for non-EU/EEA and non-Swiss students in English-taught programmes.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Percentages and availability differ by degree programme; Epidemiology and Biomedical Data Science has no Early Bird discount and no waiver, and Education for Global Futures and Leadership and Learning, Education and Technology carry only 5% early-bird discounts.
official.duration: The Early Bird discount applies to the first year of studies; tuition fee waivers run from the second year onwards for the remaining study right
official.description: The University of Oulu charges tuition fees to non-EU/EEA and non-Swiss students in English-taught Bachelor's and Master's programmes and offers no scholarship covering 100% of the fee. Support instead takes the form of a programme-specific Early Bird discount on the first year, granted by paying promptly, and tuition fee waivers from the second year for students who complete at least 60 ECTS credits.
official.program_type: Programme-specific early-bird tuition discount and progress-based tuition fee waiver

verification.notes: Read the University of Oulu tuition fees and scholarships page for international applicants, including the programme-specific bachelor's and master's tables, the Nokia scholarship section and the FAQ. No single amount is published because every figure is a percentage of a programme-specific fee, so funding_amount is left null.

applicant_utility.summary: Read this as a prompt-payment reward, not a scholarship you win: the first-year discount is 5% to 30% of your programme's fee and is simply granted if you pay within three weeks of the results, with no application and no assessment. From year two the waiver is earned by completing at least 60 ECTS in the previous year, including the required Finnish language studies, so the Finnish courses are a funding condition rather than an optional extra. Check your programme's percentage before you commit, because the same 60 ECTS buys a 40% waiver in Architecture and only 10% in Learning, Education and Technology.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Non-EU/EEA applicants admitted to an Oulu English-taught programme who can pay the first-year fee quickly and who can sustain 60 ECTS a year alongside Finnish studies.
application_readiness_checklist: Look up your exact programme in the tables and note both the Early Bird percentage and the year-two waiver percentage
Arrange the full first-year fee as one payment before results are published - instalments are not allowed in year one
Have the Finnish language studies built into your approved study plan from day one
Confirm the exact payment deadline on the bachelor's or master's application timeline and deadlines page
If you target the Nokia Scholarship, check its published details for your programme since further information was still pending
common_rejection_risks: Missing the three-week payment window, which forfeits the entire first-year discount
Completing only 55-59 ECTS in a year, which leaves you below the 60 ECTS threshold and liable for the full fee
Skipping the required Finnish language studies, which are part of the 60 ECTS condition
Assuming the percentage transfers between programmes when moving from a bachelor's to a master's phase
Losing credits earned remotely or during registration as absent, which blocks refunds if plans change
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Living expenses entirely, since the tuition fee explicitly excludes accommodation, meals, transport and personal costs; plus the unwaived 60-95% of tuition depending on programme and year.
document_audit: There is no scholarship form, so the payment transaction is the document of record for the Early Bird discount
Flywire is the only payment route and the link arrives in the admission offer email
For the year-two waiver the evidence is the transcript of 60 ECTS credits inside your approved study plan
If your residence permit status changes before registration, you must show the new permit to keep the fee exemption
alerts: There is no first-year scholarship at all: faculty-funded support starts from year two
New students must pay the full first-year fee in a single payment; instalments only exist from year two in some faculties
Epidemiology and Biomedical Data Science has neither an Early Bird discount nor a waiver, so plan for the full EUR 10,000 a year
Any credits earned during the academic year, even online or minor, remove your right to a tuition refund
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Admission, then payment through Flywire within three weeks of the results for the Early Bird discount, then annual registration and automatic waiver assessment from the second year onwards.
